svg.aria-label: Two workflows from the same task, parsing Xcode 27 project files, to the same goal, build settings checked in CI. Without sota-anchor, the agent rebuilds it from scratch: strip trailing commas, model the project, resolve build settings, write a rule engine, write the CLI and tests; 755 lines of new code, 2 min 37 s. With sota-anchor, it checks what exists first, finds xcode-project-format, Apple's own library for the format, published in September 2026, and reuses it; no code written, 42 s.
